questions.question:
A metallic cylindrical tube is open at both ends. The external diameter of the tube is 12 cm, and its length is 63 cm. The thickness of the metal tube everywhere is 0.4 cm. What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the tube?

 (Take pi = (22)/(7), and round off the answer to the nearest multiple of 5.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Outer radius = 6 cm, Inner radius = 5.6 cm

Total surface = outer CSA + inner CSA + 2 rings

⇒ 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² − r²)

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × 63 × (6 + 5.6) + 2 × 22/7 × (36 − 31.36)

⇒ 44 × 9 × 11.6 + 44/7 × 4.64 × 2

⇒ 4593.6 + 29.17 ≈ 4622.77

**∴ Answer = 4625**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

External diameter = 12 cm ⇒ R = 6 cm, thickness = 0.4 cm ⇒ r = 5.6 cm, height = 63 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area = Outer curved surface + Inner curved surface + Area of both ends

**Calculation:**

⇒ Outer CSA = 2πRh = 2 × 22/7 × 6 × 63 = 2376

⇒ Inner CSA = 2πrh = 2 × 22/7 × 5.6 × 63 = 2217.6

⇒ Ring area (both ends) = 2π(R² − r²)

⇒ = 2 × 22/7 × (36 − 31.36)

⇒ = 2 × 22/7 × 4.64 = 29.17

⇒ Total surface area = 2376 + 2217.6 + 29.17 = 4622.77

⇒ Rounded to nearest multiple of 5 = 4625

**∴ The correct answer is 4625.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hollow Cylinder Surface Area

Total area = 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² − r²)

Thickness Relation

Inner radius = Outer radius − thickness

Rounding Rule

Nearest multiple of 5 means rounding to closest number divisible by 5.

questions.question: In a race, an athlete covers a distance of 390 m in 65 sec in the first lap. He covers the second lap of the same length in 195 sec. What is the average speed (in m/sec) of the athlete?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 390 + 390 = 780 m

Total time = 65 + 195 = 260 sec

⇒ Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

⇒ = 780 ÷ 260 = 3

**∴ Answer = 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance per lap = 390 m, Time taken = 65 sec and 195 sec

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 390 + 390 = 780 m

⇒ Total time = 65 + 195 = 260 sec

⇒ Average speed = 780 ÷ 260

⇒ = 3 m/sec

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Concept

Average speed = Total distance travelled ÷ Total time taken.

Equal Distance Case

When distances are equal, average speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y), where x and y are speeds.

Unit Consistency

Always keep units consistent (meters and seconds here).

questions.question: A cistern has a hole in the bottom through which water is leaking. A tap can fill the cistern in 3 hours and the hole in the bottom can empty the fully filled cistern in 5 hours. If both the tap and the hole are open, then what will be the time taken to completely fill the empty cistern?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Tap fills in 3 hrs ⇒ rate = 1/3

Hole empties in 5 hrs ⇒ rate = −1/5

Net rate = 1/3 − 1/5 = (5 − 3)/15 = 2/15

⇒ Time = 15/2 = 7.5 hrs

**∴ Answer = 7.5 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Tap fills in 3 hours, hole empties in 5 hours

**Formula used:**

Net work rate = Filling rate − Emptying rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total work = 15 units (LCM of 3 and 5)

⇒ Tap fills = 15 ÷ 3 = 5 units/hour

⇒ Hole empties = 15 ÷ 5 = 3 units/hour

⇒ Net work = 5 − 3 = 2 units/hour

⇒ Time to fill = 15 ÷ 2 = 7.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Concept

Filling is positive work, emptying is negative work.

Net Efficiency

Net rate = Sum of individual rates considering signs.

LCM Method

Take total work as LCM of times to simplify calculations.

questions.question: Sarah's age is 5 years more than twice her sister Emma's age. If the sum of their ages is 29 years, how old is Sarah?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Emma = x ⇒ Sarah = 2x + 5

Sum = 29 ⇒ x + (2x + 5) = 29

⇒ 3x + 5 = 29 ⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8 ⇒ Sarah = 2×8 + 5 = 21

**∴ Answer = 21**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sarah = 2 × Emma + 5, Sum of ages = 29

**Formula used:**

Form linear equation using given relation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Emma’s age = x

⇒ Sarah’s age = 2x + 5

⇒ Total = x + (2x + 5) = 29

⇒ 3x + 5 = 29

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Sarah’s age = 2 × 8 + 5 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Concept

Translate statements into equations and solve step by step.

Age Relation

Represent unknown age with a variable for easier calculation.

Substitution Method

Use expressions in terms of one variable to form a single equation.

questions.question: If 5x⁺¹ = 1 , what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Any non-zero number raised to power 0 gives 1

⇒ 5x⁺¹ = 1 ⇒ exponent must be 0

⇒ x + 1 = 0

⇒ x = −1

**∴ Answer = −1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5x⁺¹ = 1

**Formula used:**

a⁰ = 1 (for a ≠ 0)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Since base 5 ≠ 1, exponent must be 0

⇒ x + 1 = 0

⇒ x = −1

**∴ The correct answer is −1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exponent Rule

a⁰ = 1 for any non-zero number a.

Exponential Equations

If base is same, equate exponents; if result is 1, exponent must be 0.

Special Case

Only 1aⁿy ⁿumber = 1, otherwise exponent = 0.

questions.question: The value of (3)/(4)(sin² 3x - tan² 3x) + (3)/(4)(cos² 3x + sec² 3x) is _____.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Group terms smartly

⇒ (sin²3x + cos²3x) + (sec²3x − tan²3x)

⇒ 1 + 1 = 2

⇒ Total = (3/4) × 2 = 3/2 = 1.5

**∴ Answer = 1.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(3/4)(sin²3x − tan²3x) + (3/4)(cos²3x + sec²3x)

**Concept Used:**

Trigonometric identities

**Calculation:**

⇒ = (3/4)[sin²3x + cos²3x + sec²3x − tan²3x]

⇒ = (3/4)[1 + (sec²3x − tan²3x)]

⇒ = (3/4)[1 + 1]

⇒ = (3/4) × 2

⇒ = 3/2 = 1.5

**∴ The correct answer is 1.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Sec–Tan Identity

sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

Simplification Tip

Always group terms to apply identities directly.

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 33°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 3 : 8, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a quadrilateral, angle between bisectors of adjacent angles = 180 − (R + S)/2

⇒ 33 = 180 − (R + S)/2

⇒ (R + S)/2 = 147 ⇒ R + S = 294

⇒ P + Q = 360 − 294 = 66

⇒ Ratio 3 : 8 ⇒ P = 18, Q = 48

**∴ Answer = 30**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS, bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at T, ∠STR = 33°

**Formula used:**

Sum of interior angles of quadrilateral = 360°

**Calculation:**

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. A square has its perimeter equal to the perimeter of the triangle. If the difference between their areas is 48 cm², find the perimeter of the triangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

3 : 4 : 5 ⇒ right triangle ⇒ area = (1/2) × 3x × 4x = 6x²

Perimeter = 12x ⇒ square side = 12x ÷ 4 = 3x

Square area = (3x)² = 9x²

Difference = 9x² − 6x² = 3x² = 48

⇒ x² = 16 ⇒ x = 4

**∴ Answer = 48**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of triangle = 3x, 4x, 5x; difference of areas = 48 cm²

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height, Area of square = side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Triangle is right-angled ⇒ area = (1/2) × 3x × 4x = 6x²

⇒ Perimeter of triangle = 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x

⇒ Square side = 12x ÷ 4 = 3x

⇒ Square area = (3x)² = 9x²

⇒ Difference = 9x² − 6x² = 3x²

⇒ 3x² = 48 ⇒ x² = 16 ⇒ x = 4

⇒ Perimeter = 12x = 48 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplet

3 : 4 : 5 triangle is always right-angled.

Perimeter Relation

Square side = perimeter ÷ 4 when perimeters are equal.

Area Comparison

Use algebraic expressions to equate difference of areas.

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 77 runs over 12 innings. If he scores 266 runs in the 13th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in 12 innings = 77 × 12 = 924

New total = 924 + 266 = 1190

New average = 1190 ÷ 13 ≈ 91.54

Increase = 91.54 − 77 = 14.54

**∴ Answer = 15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average after 12 innings = 77, Runs in 13th inning = 266

**Formula used:**

Total runs = Average × Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 12 innings = 77 × 12 = 924

⇒ Total runs after 13 innings = 924 + 266 = 1190

⇒ New average = 1190 ÷ 13 = 91.54 (approx)

⇒ Increase in average = 91.54 − 77 = 14.54

⇒ Rounded value = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

Shortcut Concept

New average depends on difference between new value and old average.

Rounding Rule

Round decimal to nearest whole number (0.5 and above rounds up).

questions.question: What price should Kunal mark on a hoodie which cost him ₹8,400, so as to gain 25% after allowing successive discounts of 20% and 25%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price = 8400, Gain 25% ⇒ SP = 8400 × 1.25 = 10500

Successive discounts: 20% and 25%

⇒ Net factor = 0.8 × 0.75 = 0.6

⇒ SP = 0.6 × MP

⇒ MP = 10500 ÷ 0.6 = 17500

**∴ Answer = 17500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP = 8400, Gain = 25%, Discounts = 20% and 25%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Gain%) and SP = MP × (1 − d1) × (1 − d2)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 8400 × (125 ÷ 100) = 10500

⇒ After discounts, SP = MP × 0.8 × 0.75

⇒ SP = MP × 0.6

⇒ 10500 = MP × 0.6

⇒ MP = 10500 ÷ 0.6

⇒ MP = 17500

**∴ The correct answer is 17500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net factor = (1 − d1) × (1 − d2)

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ Net discount factor

questions.question: Evaluate: 3⁵ times 7⁵ div 21³
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

3⁵ × 7⁵ = (3×7)⁵ = 21⁵

⇒ 21⁵ ÷ 21³ = 21²

⇒ = 441

**∴ Answer = 441**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3⁵ × 7⁵ ÷ 21³

**Concept Used:**

Exponent laws: am × bm = (ab)m, am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3⁵ × 7⁵ = (3×7)⁵ = 21⁵

⇒ 21⁵ ÷ 21³ = 21⁵−³

⇒ = 21²

⇒ = 441

**∴ The correct answer is 441.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exponent Rule

am × bm = (ab)m

Division Rule

am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

Simplification Tip

Combine same powers before applying division.

questions.question: There were two candidates in an election. One candidate got 28% of the total valid votes and lost by 13,200 votes. Find the total number of valid votes.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Losing candidate = 28%, so winner = 72%

Difference = 72 − 28 = 44%

⇒ 44% = 13200 votes

⇒ Total votes = 13200 ÷ 0.44 = 30000

**∴ Answer = 30000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One candidate got 28%, difference in votes = 13200

**Formula used:**

Difference in votes = (Difference in percentage ÷ 100) × Total votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Winning candidate = 100 − 28 = 72%

⇒ Difference = 72% − 28% = 44%

⇒ 44% of total votes = 13200

⇒ (44 ÷ 100) × Total = 13200

⇒ Total = 13200 × 100 ÷ 44

⇒ Total = 30000

**∴ The correct answer is 30000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Concept

Total votes are split between candidates; difference depends on percentage gap.

Percentage Difference

Difference% = Winning% − Losing%

Shortcut

Total = Difference ÷ Difference% (in decimal form)

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 25, 92, 48, 17, 38, 93, 37, 90 and 73 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use pairing: (25+92), (48+17), (38+93), (37+90), +73

⇒ 117 + 65 + 131 + 127 + 73 = 513

Total numbers = 9

⇒ Mean = 513 ÷ 9 = 57

**∴ Answer = 57**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 25, 92, 48, 17, 38, 93, 37, 90, 73

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ Number of observations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum = 25 + 92 + 48 + 17 + 38 + 93 + 37 + 90 + 73

⇒ Sum = 513

⇒ Number of observations = 9

⇒ Mean = 513 ÷ 9

⇒ Mean = 57

**∴ The correct answer is 57.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

Mean = Total sum ÷ Number of values

Pairing Method

Group numbers to simplify addition quickly.

Shortcut Tip

Use symmetric pairs to reduce calculation time.

questions.question: Two trains, X and Y, are running along parallel tracks towards each other. The length of train X is 150 m, and the length of train Y is 250 m. Train X is running at a speed of 60 km/hr, and train Y is running at a speed of 90 km/hr. How much time will it take for train X to cross train Y?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 150 + 250 = 400 m

Relative speed = 60 + 90 = 150 km/hr

⇒ Convert: 150 × 5/18 = 41.67 m/s

⇒ Time = 400 ÷ 41.67 ≈ 9.6 sec

**∴ Answer = 9.6 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of X = 150 m, Length of Y = 250 m, Speeds = 60 km/hr and 90 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 150 + 250 = 400 m

⇒ Relative speed = 60 + 90 = 150 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed: 150 × 5/18 = 41.67 m/s

⇒ Time = 400 ÷ 41.67

⇒ Time ≈ 9.6 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 9.6 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds are added.

Train Crossing Rule

Total distance = sum of lengths of both trains.

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 8 February 2023 to 22 April 2023.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Days: Feb (20 days) + March (31 days) + April (22 days) = 73 days

⇒ Time = 73/365 = 1/5 year

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ = 2800 ÷ 100 = 28

**∴ Answer = 28**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P = 2000, R = 7% per annum, Time = from 8 Feb to 22 April

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ February days = 28 − 8 = 20 days

⇒ March = 31 days

⇒ April = 22 days

⇒ Total days = 20 + 31 + 22 = 73 days

⇒ Time in years = 73/365 = 1/5

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 2800 ÷ 100 = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Time Conversion

Convert days into years by dividing by 365.

Shortcut

If days simplify to fraction of year, use directly to reduce calculation.

questions.question: A sells to B at 20% profit, B sells to C at 25% loss, C sells to D at 40% profit. D pays ₹252. How much did A pay originally?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option1. The detailed solution will be updated soon. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let A's cost = x

⇒ After A→B: x × 1.2

⇒ After B→C: x × 1.2 × 0.75

⇒ After C→D: x × 1.2 × 0.75 × 1.4 = 252

⇒ x × 1.26 = 252 ⇒ x = 200

**∴ Answer = 200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit 20%, Loss 25%, Profit 40%, Final price = 252

**Formula used:**

Final Price = Initial Price × successive multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let A’s cost price = x

⇒ A to B: x × (120/100) = 1.2x

⇒ B to C: 1.2x × (75/100) = 0.9x

⇒ C to D: 0.9x × (140/100) = 1.26x

⇒ 1.26x = 252

⇒ x = 252 ÷ 1.26

⇒ x = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Profit/Loss

Use multipliers: (1 ± p/100)

Combined Multiplier

Multiply all factors to get final relation.

Reverse Calculation

Divide final price by combined factor to get original price.

questions.question: If x+6 is the HCF of x² + 10x + 24 and x² + kx + 12 , then the value of k is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If (x + 6) is HCF ⇒ x = −6 is common root

Put x = −6 in second polynomial

⇒ 36 − 6k + 12 = 0

⇒ 48 − 6k = 0 ⇒ k = 8

**∴ Answer = 8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = (x + 6), Polynomials: x² + 10x + 24 and x² + kx + 12

**Formula used:**

If (x + a) is a factor ⇒ polynomial becomes 0 at x = −a

**Calculation:**

⇒ Since (x + 6) is common factor, put x = −6

⇒ In second polynomial:

⇒ (−6)² + k(−6) + 12 = 0

⇒ 36 − 6k + 12 = 0

⇒ 48 − 6k = 0

⇒ 6k = 48

⇒ k = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Factor Theorem

If (x − a) is a factor, then f(a) = 0

HCF of Polynomials

Common factor must satisfy both polynomials.

Shortcut Tip

Substitute root directly instead of full factorization.

questions.question: The number of prime numbers between 368 and 376 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check odd numbers only: 369, 371, 373, 375

369 divisible by 3, 375 divisible by 3 and 5

371 = 7 × 53 (not prime)

373 not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 ⇒ prime

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers between 368 and 376

**Formula used:**

A prime number has only two factors: 1 and itself

**Calculation:**

⇒ 369: divisible by 3 ⇒ not prime

⇒ 370: even ⇒ not prime

⇒ 371: 7 × 53 ⇒ not prime

⇒ 372: even ⇒ not prime

⇒ 373: not divisible by primes up to √373 ⇒ prime

⇒ 374: even ⇒ not prime

⇒ 375: divisible by 3 and 5 ⇒ not prime

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Check

Test divisibility up to √n only.

Quick Elimination

Remove even numbers and multiples of 3, 5 first.

Small Factors

Check primes like 7, 11, 13 for faster validation.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 86 and their difference is 12. Find the product of the two numbers.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product = (Sum² − Difference²) ÷ 4

⇒ = (86² − 12²) ÷ 4

⇒ = (7396 − 144) ÷ 4 = 7252 ÷ 4

⇒ = 1813

**∴ Answer = 1813**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum = 86, Difference = 12

**Formula used:**

x + y = 86 and x − y = 12

**Calculation:**

⇒ Add equations: 2x = 98 ⇒ x = 49

⇒ Substitute: 49 + y = 86 ⇒ y = 37

⇒ Product = 49 × 37

⇒ = 1813

**∴ The correct answer is 1813.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebra Identity

(x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy

System of Equations

Solve using addition or substitution method.

Shortcut Use

Use identity directly to avoid solving variables.

questions.question: A total profit of ₹28,800 is to be distributed amongst P, Q and R such that P : Q = 17 : 5 and Q : R = 6 : 12. The share (in ₹) of Q in the profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make Q same: P : Q = 17 : 5 and Q : R = 6 : 12

⇒ LCM of 5 and 6 = 30

⇒ P : Q = 102 : 30 and Q : R = 30 : 60

⇒ Final ratio = 102 : 30 : 60

Total parts = 192

⇒ Q’s share = (30/192) × 28800 = 4500

**∴ Answer = 4500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P : Q = 17 : 5, Q : R = 6 : 12, Total profit = 28800

**Formula used:**

Equalize common term (Q) to combine ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ P : Q = 17 : 5 ⇒ multiply by 6 ⇒ 102 : 30

⇒ Q : R = 6 : 12 ⇒ multiply by 5 ⇒ 30 : 60

⇒ Combined ratio = 102 : 30 : 60

⇒ Total parts = 102 + 30 + 60 = 192

⇒ Q’s share = (30/192) × 28800

⇒ = 30 × 150 = 4500

**∴ The correct answer is 4500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

Equalize common term before merging ratios.

Profit Distribution

Share = (Part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount

Shortcut

Convert to common ratio directly to save time.

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 75% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for ₹69,356. Find its marked price (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

75% discount ⇒ customer pays 25%

⇒ SP = 25% of MP

⇒ MP = 69356 ÷ 0.25

⇒ = 69356 × 4 = 277424

**∴ Answer = 277424**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price = 69356, Discount = 75%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × (25/100)

⇒ 69356 = MP × 0.25

⇒ MP = 69356 ÷ 0.25

⇒ MP = 277424

**∴ The correct answer is 277424.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

If discount is d%, then SP = MP × (100 − d)/100

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ remaining percentage

Shortcut Tip

75% discount means SP is 1/4 of MP, so multiply by 4.

questions.question: Suman, Tariq and Neha invest sums in the ratio 8 : 25 : 15, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹44,544 at the end of the year, then what is the positive difference between the shares of Suman and Neha?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio = 8 : 25 : 15 ⇒ Total parts = 48

⇒ 1 part = 44544 ÷ 48 = 928

⇒ Suman = 8 × 928 = 7424

⇒ Neha = 15 × 928 = 13920

⇒ Difference = 13920 − 7424 = 6496

**∴ Answer = 6496**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio = 8 : 25 : 15, Total profit = 44544

**Formula used:**

Share = (Part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total parts = 8 + 25 + 15 = 48

⇒ Value of 1 part = 44544 ÷ 48 = 928

⇒ Suman’s share = 8 × 928 = 7424

⇒ Neha’s share = 15 × 928 = 13920

⇒ Difference = 13920 − 7424 = 6496

**∴ The correct answer is 6496.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Distribution

Profit is shared in the ratio of investment when time is same.

Unit Method

Find value of one part first for easy calculation.

Difference Shortcut

Difference = (Difference in parts × value of one part).
